anna_white_space: EVERY major player is Western, voice/PMS-centric, English. NONE is CIS/Telegram-native with indistinguishable-human RUSSIAN warmth. ANNA's lane = Telegram-first CIS + warmth + stealth-human. RISK: ANNA today lacks PMS/CRM integration + reminders that are competitor table-stakes — roadmap must add booking-system integration + reminders.

buyer_psychology.central_barrier: patient TRUST — patients hesitant about AI (only ~10% comfortable with AI diagnoses, Statista 2023)
buyer_psychology.good_news_for_anna: administrative/booking is the HIGHEST-comfort AI use case (low stakes); some patients trust it MORE 'due to lack of judgment' — exactly ANNA's job
owner_objections: ошибка ИИ → удар по репутации (кейс Tessa)

why: 1) Booking is precisely the use case patients ALREADY accept from AI — so full stealth may be UNNECESSARY for adoption.
2) The research-backed trust builders are TRANSPARENCY + human-reachable + hybrid — the opposite of masking.
3) Detection risk = reputational damage (Tessa), and the owner's #1 fear is exactly a patient feeling deceived/unheard.
counterpoint_preserving_creator_choice: In CIS/Telegram, warmth + indistinguishable Russian may still be a real differentiator vs cold Western voice bots.
The 'lack of judgment' comfort does NOT require disclosure to capture.
Stealth + flawless human handoff can still work IF quality never slips.
guardian_verdict_on_stealth.recommendation: REVISIT toward a 'warm, lightly-transparent, always-human-reachable' stance (research-optimal) — OR keep stealth but treat the human-handoff + never-slip-quality mitigations as NON-negotiable launch gates. CREATOR DECISION; not overridden.
guardian_verdict_on_stealth.verdict: STRATEGY SURVIVES; disclosure stance flagged as the single highest-leverage risk, now with hard evidence.
